pose: The Xiaotingia is in a state of comedic distress, standing on one leg while the other foot is lifted to its open beak in a 'checking the damage' gesture. Its head is cocked back, eyes bulging and looking downward toward the dark charcoal-grey volcanic ash floor. Its long, decorative tail feathers are ruffled and fanned out in agitation. A single, tiny white tooth is visible resting on a nearby volcanic rock, just out of the creature's line of sight, as it lets out a silent, pained 'huff' of steam.

visual_logic.substrate: Volcanic Tuff and dark silt with visible ash dusting

behavioral_intent: High-fidelity expressive physical comedy conveying: 'My mouth hurts and I think I dropped a tooth around here somewhere'.
